reponse: The Go-Live Date is December 7, 2026, per the signed agreement [1]. If Quillon causes a delay, Tradewell receives service credits of 5% of monthly platform fees per full week of delay, capped at 25%, as the sole remedy [1]. Tomer Golan owns the cutover end to end on Quillon's side — payout engine config, webhooks, and the go/no-go checklist [2] — while Ellen is Tradewell's internal owner, committing to deliver the KYC file for the first 400 sellers by December 2 [2]. Note the go-live is conditional on Tradewell completing onboarding obligations five business days prior [1].
